description: Mixed-source technical atlas: 6 poses retaken on 2026-11-12 at 346f7986 (Dâmbovița free of grass with quay edges; two church models redrawn); all other images retain their recorded sources and dates.
coverageNote: 98 captured 250 m squares: 26 touch the playable mask, 66 additional squares touch its exact 600 m ring and 6 are optional distant context. Boundary squares also include land beyond the ring.
reviewNote: Sign-affected current game captures inspected at full size; source/aerial comparisons retain their historical scope. No district fidelity acceptance.

collectionNotes.atlas: Mixed-source technical atlas: 6 poses retaken on 2026-11-12 at 346f7986 (Dâmbovița free of grass with quay edges; two church models redrawn); all other images retain their recorded sources and dates.

sourceCaptureManifest.note: Derived current mixed-source ledger; all exact original and retake capture ledgers remain separately retained.

aerial.attribution: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
aerial.delivery: Live provider request; no aerial or Street View imagery is distributed.
aerial.extent: 250 m ground square at the listed WGS84 centre; EPSG:3857 with latitude scale correction.

review.status: Nine affected original-pose game frames inspected at full size after physical fountain/rim tree correction. Earlier comparison reviews remain historical; no new photographic-parity claim.
review.purpose: Source-led inspection and complete capture evidence; no exact visual-parity claim.
limitations: North-up square perspective game cameras and off-nadir reference imagery displace elevated roofs differently. Reference acquisition dates remain unknown; the comparison is not a pixel registration score.

Literal OSM heights, minima, footprints and courtyard rings stay authoritative over an apparent imagery conflict. Untagged heights, roof rises, facade materials, cornices and detailed roof forms remain estimates or native approximations.

Historic blocks and the Unirea roof retain simplified roof detail; broad source mass and courtyard coverage do not establish exact architectural parity. Canopy crown form and density still differ visibly from the aerial imagery.

Historical earlier review: The dataset retains 15758 mapped/measured tree entries. This capture places 15723; 35 geometric exclusions remain explicit: 31 road checks, three mapped centres inside source buildings, one measured centre inside mapped water. No tree cap is reached.

Only 23 independently reviewed non-crown detections were removed from the raw Unirii survey. Raw candidate evidence and all other source trees remain preserved; this is not an individual validation of every automated crown candidate.
Five contradictory literal source height/minimum profiles remain preserved and rejected by native roof compilation; four dependent roof caches use complete-source fallback.
All optional distant squares lie outside the required 600 m ring and retain coarse contextual treatment. The Cathedral reference shows an older construction state.

These world-only top-down captures disable moving traffic and mirrors. Full public-road Street View, public movement, grade/bridge clearance, drone-controller coverage and evolving traffic/mirror budgets remain separate gates.

Current b2c4ea4a district retains18,590tree instances after16explicit basin/rim conflicts; source tree arrays are unchanged. Full source/native parity is recorded in fix-fountain-trees/summary.json. Unrelated roofs, street markings, water boundaries and estimated scenery remain under review.
review.atlasSourceNote: Current source counts: 80 on 0775fdaf, 17 on bbaffc0d, 1 on 07cc3d6b. Earlier source-specific review blocks remain historical to their recorded revisions; the new structural subset has its own linked review.
review.visualAcceptance: All17actual before/current/private-Esri pairs inspected. Exact source water polygons remain; overlapping estimated fallback ribbons are clipped. Capture completeness is not photographic parity.
targetedRemainingGaps: Estimated facade details, building heights, source roof profiles and vegetation differ from real views; source polygons alone do not establish full visual parity.
OSM water/river bank polygons and unknown independent imagery acquisition dates remain explicit; this correction does not claim a new surveyed riverbank.
World-only high top-down frames hide moving traffic/mirrors and use technical camera/fog bounds; native movement and budgets have separate tests.

priorCompleteReview.note: Every earlier review/source-specific finding is preserved verbatim in the complete prior collection.

sourceCaptureManifests.note: Previous complete current manifest with actual per-frame source dates; its original raw capture ledger is also archived.

visualAcceptance: Nine current game frames visually inspected. Earlier paired source/aerial comparisons retain their actual dates and scope. Current capture completeness is not photographic parity.

sourceCompatibility.method: Replaced every atlas square within50m of the16excluded physical trunk bodies, preserving all original poses. All other frames retain original pixels/source/date. Basin geometry and source data hashes unchanged; no canopy-budget thinning.

signRefresh.scope: Conservative camera-frustum sphere intersections, 30m sign/shadow margin. Unplaced sign includes whole source building. No occlusion or distance culling assumed. Every condition of affected walking viewpoints included. Isolated model studies and standalone tourist scenes do not use district unit fascias.
